name: Hollow Voxel Rasterization
definition: Generates a 3D voxel mesh representing the hollow shell of an arbitrary polyhedron by iterating over triangles, computing their voxel-space bounding boxes, and marking intersected voxels.
summary: Hollow Voxel Rasterization generates a memory-efficient voxel shell from a polyhedron by marking voxels containing mesh faces, avoiding solid interior filling.
